author: The Current
description:
Anna Graves talks about the mixed emotions of playing the Opry the day Dolly Parton died
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

When Minnesota singer-songwriter Anna Graves made her Grand Ole Opry debut in Nashville — truly an honor and a milestone for any country or Americana artist — it was a bittersweet day because it also happened to be the day everyone learned that Dolly Parton had died. Graves reflects on what that day and on what Dolly Parton both mean to her. “Dolly would want you to get up on that stage and to tell your truth,” Graves says.

Watch more from Graves' interview with The Current's Zach McCormick in the video above.

Watch Humbird perform "Blood Moon" live in an Eau Claire coffeehouse
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

When the Eaux Claires Festival returned in the summer of 2026, The Current and Radio Milwaukee teamed up for a live broadcast from Shift Coffee Bar in Eau Claire, Wisconsin. On Thursday, July 23, singer-songwriter Siri Undlin — who heads the music project Humbird — performed a set of three songs from her forthcoming album, "Morning When It Comes," releasing Friday, Sept. 25.

Watch a performance of "Blood Moon" above.
